en: Sepia-toned historic coastal scene showing a small harbor with whitewashed buildings along the waterfront and hills behind. In the foreground, people stand and sit on a low wall near the shore, some with luggage and a pack animal. In the bay are two masted ships, one flying a Greek flag. Handwritten Greek text appears along the bottom edge, and a faint round emblem plus the website 'www.elia.org.gr' are visible.
